Mario Pierre Romance: A selfless foreign friend of our Liberation War
2023-07-21T23:02:47+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/culture-multimedia/news/mario-pierre-romance-selfless-foreign-friend-our-liberation-war-3375321

In 1971, citizens from different countries came forward to help us without thinking about their own self. They helped us in many ways which includes forming public opinion and sympathy in favour of our Liberation War. Belgian resident Mario Pierre Romance was one of them who played a huge role in spite of the risk to his life. While raising money for the freedom-desiring people of this land, he even served jail time in his own country.
